}}'''The Announcement and the Prize''' (Japanese: '''発表！！ これが優勝商品！''' ''Announcement!! This is the Grand Prize!'') is the fifth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Sun}} defeats the [[Professor Kukui|Masked Royal]] and advances to the next round.
* [[Hala]] reveals the prize for winning the [[Iki Town festival tournament]] is an [[island challenge]] amulet.
* [[Gladion]] battles against [[Hau]] in the next battle.
* [[Guzma]] arrives at [[Iki Town]] and announces that he is taking {{tc|Team Skull Grunt|Grunt A}}'s place in the tournament.
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
